thematicPolicy.color: Already added in previous pass; no new color tags.
thematicPolicy.season: Add only visually observable forests, flowers, mountains, water or other meaningful backgrounds.
thematicPolicy.night: Add only visibly nighttime or moonlit artwork, not dark-color-only art.
thematicPolicy.street: Add only artwork with visibly identifiable town/building/street context.
thematicPolicy.sunset: Add only evident horizon or sunset, not every orange-dominant background.
thematicPolicy.work: Add when an occupational act/setting is clearly illustrated.
thematicPolicy.sleeping: Do not infer sleeping from names/closed eyes in low-resolution contact sheets.
thematicPolicy.reflections: Do not infer reflections from metallic or glass textures.
thematicPolicy.connected: Do not invent linked illustrations without confirmed cross-card continuation.
thematicPolicy.evolution: Do not infer an evolution story merely because an evolution-line member appears.
thematicPolicy.food: Do not infer food theme without identifiable preparation or dining.
thematicPolicy.cameo: Do not infer extra Pokémon from background graphics without clear confirmation.
